lines.text: The LORD stirred Cyrus king of Persia to proclaim that God's people should go to Jerusalem and build His house.
The family heads of Judah and Benjamin, with the priests and Levites, prepared to go, and their neighbors gave them silver and gold.
Cyrus brought out the articles Nebuchadnezzar had carried away, and Mithredath the treasurer counted them out to Daniel the prince of Judah.
The priests who could not find their family records were excluded from the priesthood, and the governor told them not to eat the most holy things.
On arriving at the house of the LORD, some family heads gave freewill offerings and 61,000 darics of gold and 5,000 minas of bronze.
